code.description: Machine-readable error code (e.g., TOKEN_EXPIRED) - present only for certain errors

requestId.description: Duplicate X-Request-Id header - include this when reporting an error

job.description: Available in list/detail views; field sets vary by endpoint.

employer.description: Only available in the detail/list endpoint that includes an employer join.
